card.name: "From" after removal verbs
card.fires_on: The word "from" right after verbs of removing, expelling or keeping away, such as removed, expelled, kept. Also weakly on nouns like containers or samples.

modes.label: from after removal verb
modes.description: "From" follows removed, expelled or kept and introduces what something is taken out of.
